title: Preference hedging for reserved GPU lanes with hosted backstop
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Implement a hedging + containment policy that prefers routing to a customer's reserved GPU lanes (Dedicated) while using a controlled hosted backstop when capacity or SLO risk is detected. This ticket captures the engineering plan, decision trade-offs, configuration knobs, observability, and rollout/runbook for the feature.
acceptance_criteria: Routing decision engine can express a per-tenant preference weight that biases towards dedicated pools but allows a bounded probability of choosing hosted as a backstop.

A configurable 'quarantine' containment path exists for requests routed to hosted backstop: tokens are limited, response quality logged, and fallback variants (smaller/quantized models) can be applied automatically.
Telemetry events emitted for every decision: route.chosen, route.reason, fallback.variant, capacity.signal, and hedging.decision, visible in the routing dashboard.

SLOs remain protected: automated circuit-breaker trips when p95 latency or error rate exceeds thresholds; affected tenants fall back to deterministic policy (e.g., serve from hosted-only or deny with clear error code).
End-to-end canary rollout plan exists with at least 2 customers and a staged ramp mechanism (5% -> 25% -> 100%).
technical_notes: Hedging model: per-tenant preference_score (0..1) computed from SLA tier, recent error budget consumption, and soft-reservation tokens. Decision: if available dedicated capacity, pick dedicated; else compute P(hosted) = max(softFloor, 1 - preference_score) and sample.

Soft-reserve escrow: implement a small token bank per-tenant that holds 'hedge credits' replenished on successful dedicated serves; credits allow transient deviation from strict dedicated-only routing.

Quarantine containment: hosted backstop requests go through a limited-capacity queue with extra telemetry and optional model variant demotion (quantized or distilled model); responses tagged with trace header and quality score.

Circuit breaker conditions: rolling window (1m/5m) p95 latency > configured_threshold OR error_rate > configured_error_rate -> trip for tenant-region for duration d. Implement exponential backoff before retrying hedging behavior.

Compatibility shim: model variant compatibility matrix required to ensure that hosted fallback models are API-compatible (tokenization, role/stop semantics). Incompatible variants must be converted or blocked.
Safety knobs: global spill_cap per-region, per-tenant max_backstop_rate, and a hard limit that prevents more than X% of requests routing to hosted in a single AZ to protect noisy neighbors.

Metrics: emit route.decision_latency, route.queue_length, backstop.quality_score, hedging.credit_balance. Update existing dashboards to show per-tenant breakdown and alert on credit exhaustion or sudden spike in backstop rate.
Data retention/PII: requests in quarantine are logged at reduced fidelity by default; full payload capture requires customer opt-in and is gated by security_review_required flag.
